run_body2hands_demo: run the body2hands demo script on frankmocap SMPLX predictions using a pretrained checkpoint model
run_save_output: save SMPLX body pose predictions to MTC format text files with camera and shape parameters
run_load_smplx: load SMPLX prediction pickle files from frankmocap output and extract body pose and camera data
run_main_pipeline: run the full body2hands pipeline with standardization, model inference, and MTC format output saving
run_aa_to_rot6d_conversion: convert axis-angle rotation representations to 6D rotation format for SMPL arm joints
